honesty.rule: When a venue has fewer than three eligible drills, say so plainly and offer what exists. Never pad a session with drills that do not fit the facility.
honesty.example: Two drills fit a mirror and nothing else. Here they are — about 14 minutes.

home_mirror.note: No ball, no space. Short and focused or not at all.

home_putting.note: Carpet work stays sharp for about twenty minutes.

home_swing.note: Foam and small swings. Quality drops off quickly.

net.note: No ball flight, so attention fades sooner than on a range.

bunker.note: Hands and wrists tire in sand faster than people expect.

limitRule:
SESSION CEILING is additive. Sum maxBlockMinutes across the venue's capabilities, then clamp to the highest groupCeiling among those capabilities, then round DOWN to the nearest pickerOption. Switching activity resets attention, so a mirror plus a carpet is a longer session than either alone.
WITHIN a session, no single capability may exceed its own maxBlockMinutes. That is what makes combining safe: 15 minutes of mirror work plus 20 on the carpet is fine, 35 minutes of mirror work is not.
The time picker shows only options at or below the computed ceiling.
